Shawshank opened 32 years ago today and lost money. Hindi cinema has its own list:
1959 Kaagaz Ke Phool: India's first CinemaScope film and a box-office bomb. Guru Dutt never officially directed again.
1970 Mera Naam Joker: Raj Kapoor's four-hour epic. It failed; a shorter cut did well in the '80s.
1994 Andaz Apna Apna: flopped, and now everyone quotes it.
2004 Swades: a commercial disappointment that's now called one of Shah Rukh Khan's best.

Thu 24 Sept Â· Netflix: Shaque: Trust No One. Parineeti Chopra's first series, as a mother nine years into searching for her child. With Jennifer Winget and Tahir Raj Bhasin.
Fri 25 Sept Â· Prime Video: Don't Be Shy. A college rom-com produced by Alia and Shaheen Bhatt, written and directed by Sreeti Mukerji.

The Paradise opens tomorrow, Thursday 24 September. Adults only.

Nani and Srikanth Odela reunite after Dasara (2023). The CBFC gave it an A certificate; it runs 2 hours 49 minutes.
The story: a tribal community fighting for rights it has been denied, and the leader who rises from it.
Raghav Juyal, Mohan Babu and Kayadu Lohar co-star. Anirudh Ravichander does the music. Nani has called it the most tiring film of his career.
